description: This file defines a React functional component named `MultipleSelectedFiles`. The component manages the UI for when multiple files are selected, displaying the count and providing actions via a FileOptionsPanel. It uses various controllers and icons, and leverages React hooks such as `useCallback`.

methods.name: MultipleSelectedFiles
methods.description: React functional component that displays the UI when multiple files are selected, allowing users to view the count and perform bulk actions.

methods.name: cancelMultipleSelection
methods.description: A callback function created with `useCallback` to invoke `selectionController.cancelMultipleSelection()`, which cancels the current multiple selection state.
